title: DropRider
description: Host to server: remove this rider (ADR 0007 section 3). Its token is dropped, its connection gets ended `dropped` and is closed with 4403, and the host gets rider_left `dropped`.

rider.description: The rider's id: 8 random bytes, base64url without padding, given by the server at the join, never derived from the token or the nickname, the same for the token's whole life.
